title: Cajun Alfredo Tortellini
description: A flavorful and easy Cajun Alfredo Tortellini recipe inspired by a social media post.
steps: Spray your pan with olive oil and heat it.
Add butter and let it melt.
Add chopped chicken breast and season with Cajun two-step, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika.
Cook until the chicken gets a little brown, then stir.
Add frozen onions and peppers, cook until softened.
Add the cheese tortellini and cook until done.
Top with mozzarella cheese and mix everything together.
notes:
Feel free to adjust seasonings to taste and add more cheese if desired.
